propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache consumes 92% (956 MiB) of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch due to bookkeeping fields baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass that are written frequently but read nowhere or minimally.

Deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp and moving last_get_pass out-of-line reduces per-version marginal packed cost from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement) and halves version growth via rotation bookkeeping separation.

A one-time git fast-export/filter/fast-import history rewrite on a quiesced repository reduces the existing branch from 1.17 GiB to 98.8 MiB (8.4% final size) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges and keeping HEAD tree byte-identical.

The reclaim requires operator-attested gates: descendant reconciler workflow execution, live epoch-refusal proofs from review-bot and host runtimes, verified off-repo backup bundle, zero active sessions, and stopped rebar-mcp servers before publication.

Rollback after publication is achieved via explicit quiesced operator-controlled ref restoration from the off-repo bundle with mandatory writer re-clone and epoch-mismatch refusal enforcement at both union sites.

All committed-format changes share one store file and use mixed-version read compatibility and self-healing mechanisms, with ADR documentation of compatibility protocol, rollout gates, and rollback boundaries.
